summary: The guest glares, unconvinced, then turns and leaves through the kitchen door.
framing: Medium close-up, chest up, eye level; same setup as S17: purple door behind him, blue door frame and green wall at the right edge. Static.

cast.costume: navy suit, white shirt, red tie, red pocket square

props: purple door behind him; white light-switch plate on the wall at lower left, revealed from 1583

beats.action: stands square, arms down, scowling at the host off right: lids half lowered, pupils right, mouth clamped down
lids narrow further into a hard squint; glare held motionless
head dips and starts to turn toward camera, eyes drop down, shoulders begin to rotate left
head now 3/4 left, looking down-left, body turning left, moved right in frame
turn continues; screen-left hand rises into the bottom of frame
body faces left, head 3/4 left and lower in frame, hand gone, light-switch plate visible at lower left
full left profile with his back and shoulder to camera, screen-left hand raised with fingers spread at the lower left edge, reaching for the door; still moving left on the last frame

notes: Camera confirmed static (door panel lines and frame strip do not move). He does not speak; the tail of the host's line is heard over the first 3 frames. The turn is animated on twos.
